meta.parties: Chellappa Et Al v. Kumarasamy Et Al

rules.statement: A customary marriage is valid under the law, independently of registration.
rules.supporting_quote: "Generally speaking, there are three requisites for a valid marriage, namely, competency, intention to marry, and a recognized form of marriage. There is so dispute in this case as to the first two requisites, and it is equally without doubt that under our law the customary form of marriage is good, independently of registration."
